title: Prepare and file sales tax VAT or GST returns
summary: When a registered entity has a periodic indirect-tax reporting obligation. A reviewed return reconciled to transactions, with submission and payment receipts or a tracked exception.
outcomes: A reviewed return reconciled to transactions, with submission and payment receipts or a tracked exception.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When a registered entity has a periodic indirect-tax reporting obligation.

parts.title: Identify the registered accounts and reporting periods
parts.guidance: Gather account confirmations, local filing instructions, transaction locations and assigned periods. Have the tax adviser confirm which registrations require a return, including periods with no sales where applicable.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Reconcile tax transactions and adjustments
parts.guidance: Reconcile invoices, refunds, marketplace reports, exemptions, imports and input-tax evidence to the ledger. Keep disputed treatment separate and resolve missing documents without substituting a platform estimate for the source records.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Review classifications and the draft return
parts.guidance: The responsible tax reviewer confirms rates, sourcing, deduction eligibility and adjustments for the relevant jurisdiction. Record the basis for judgment calls and reconcile the draft liability with the tax-control accounts.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Review classifications and the draft return

parts.title: Authorize and submit the return and payment
parts.guidance: The authorized filer approves the declarations and submits through the correct authority account. Payments follow the company payment-approval process; retain separate submission and payment confirmations.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the reviewed account operation described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Authorize and submit the return and payment

parts.title: Reconcile authority acceptance and the next period
parts.guidance: Match receipts and account statements to the ledger and investigate rejections or differences. Calendar the next filing and route any correction through the authority's applicable amendment process.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

verify.how: A reviewed return reconciled to transactions, with submission and payment receipts or a tracked exception.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.
Editorial status: operational draft. Source pages checked on 2026-10-29. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance or completed execution is claimed.
